About

This resource hub was built as a project for CMST 387 — Principles of Web Design and Technology III. It collects and organizes useful resources from the course and the internet into one accessible, mobile-first site.

Site Info

Accessibility statement

This site targets WCAG 2.2 Level AA

Built with HTML, CSS, SASS, and vanilla JS.
